schema.description: One figure for one day's heart rate as an Open mHealth heart-rate-2.0 body (omh:heart-rate:2.0, pinned), with the source's day and which figure it is beside it. A day has up to three: resting, the minimum and the maximum. Garmin writes them through the anam_garmin importer (source garmin): resting from GarminDB's resting_hr table, minimum and maximum from its daily_summary.

id.description: The source's key for the day. For Garmin, the day as GarminDB files it, a local date.

statistic.description: Which of the day's figures this is. With id, the identity: one facet per figure per day.

heart_rate.description: The figure as an OMH unit-value, in beats per minute.

value.description: Beats per minute, as the source gave it.

effective_time_frame.description: The day Garmin counted, as an OMH time interval: Garmin Connect's own start and end, each RFC 3339 at the offset the watch was at then. A day the watch crossed zones in has two offsets (17 October 2026 runs +11:00 to +01:00, 34 hours); a day still in progress ends where Garmin had counted to. The start is the fact time. The figure covers it.

start_date_time.description: RFC 3339, the day's local midnight at the watch's offset.

end_date_time.description: RFC 3339, the next local midnight at the watch's offset, or where Garmin had counted to.

temporal_relationship_to_physical_activi.description: OMH's "at rest", on the resting figure only.

descriptive_statistic.description: OMH's statistic over the day, on the minimum and maximum figures only.

source_time.description: How Garmin's day was read (card 197): value is its date as Garmin Connect files it, read in the offset the day began at (basis source); a day Garmin gave no interval for is read in Australia/Sydney instead (basis assumption), and the importer logs it.

value.description: The fact time as the source supplied it, as text and never rewritten: a date, a wall clock, an RFC 3339 string, or an epoch as its digits.

zone.description: The zone value is read in, and nothing else: an IANA name when one is known, UTC for a value that is UTC, else a fixed offset +HH:MM or -HH:MM. The gate refuses a name that is no zone.

basis.description: Who decided the zone. source: the source supplied it with the value, or the value is UTC by the source's own definition. configuration: a setting a person made for this source names it. assumption: the importer or writer chose it, with nothing behind it but its own default or the Definition's zone, and logged that it did.
